essence: After uttering the remaining elements as before, one should place them in the svādhiṣṭhāna.
One should make the pervading placement for the goddess nādhipā, śrīparā.
The names Keśava, Nārāyaṇa, Mādhava, Govinda, and Viṣṇu are enumerated.
The series continues with Vāsudeva, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha.
The enumeration includes Ṛddhi, Rūpiṇī, Luptā, and the one who is the sole leader in cutting away faults.
